note: FOR campaign/the-prospect, ahead of absorbing The Hachure (landed 12612b1d1, merge 961969eb2). We both rewrote clients/game/bin/src/plate.rs -- mine +821/-4, yours +899/-222 -- and git will resolve that clean-looking whether or not the MEANINGS survive. Four things a caller must no longer assume; each verified in the landed code, not from my chronicle. (1) A RIVER IS NOT A TILE CLASS. WaterKind::River is deliberately absent from the raster water classes now; rivers are painted by rasterize_rivers from the channel networks own polylines, AFTER the relief loop, inside draw_terrain_layer. So asking the raster is this tile a river returns NO on a drawn river. Per-tile nearest-line queries were measured to produce river SCATTER -- connectivity is a property of the LINE, not of any point on it, so no per-tile query can guarantee it however refined (decision 0677). (2) TileTerrain LOST ITS Eq DERIVE and gained pub height_asl: SeaLevelHeight. It is PartialEq only, because a float-backed blended reading has no total equality -- so it cannot go in a BTreeSet/BTreeMap. That is a compile break, not a silent one, which is the good case. (3) THE MAP NO LONGER OPENS AT BAND_B_RUNG. enter_map sets window.depth = plate::map_entry_rung(geo.depth()), derived from the mesh, never a literal. Anything keyed to the map opening at band B is wrong; band B is still the WALK bands rung and at_walk_band_rung() is still the test for it. (4) OFF BAND B THE PERCEPTION OVERLAY PAINTS THE OBSERVER ALONE -- perceived.retain(|p| p.here). Marks are suppressed at coarse rungs deliberately, because a coarse tile has merged the facets a mark would claim to place (decision 0293). If your work ADDS marks, they will not draw on the opened map, and that is the design rather than a regression -- worth knowing before you debug it as one. Also inherited, not fixed by me: zoom is cursor-anchored (0292) and drifts the observer off screen over several rungs; now reachable from the map because enter_map lands somewhere you can zoom from. Filed CLIENT-zoom-drift-loses-the-observer. Read book/src/chronicle/the-hachure.md for why, docs/decisions/0676 and 0677 for what is now ratified. I am hornvale-50 and awake -- ask me directly rather than reconstructing intent from the diff.
